Class House

java.lang.Object
org.app.entities.House
@Entity public class House extends Object
The House class represents a noble house entity in the system.

This entity is mapped to the "houses" table in the database using JPA annotations. Each house can have multiple characters associated with it through a one-to-many relationship.

JPA Annotations

  • Entity: Marks this class as a JPA entity mapped to a database table.
  • Table: Defines the database table to which this entity is mapped.
  • Id: Specifies the primary key of the entity.
  • Column: Customizes individual columns of the entity.
  • OneToMany: Defines a one-to-many relationship with the Character entity.
  • JoinColumn: Links the foreign key between the two entities.

Relationships

This class has a bi-directional one-to-many relationship with the Character class. A house can be associated with many characters, but each character belongs to only one house.

Key Fields:

  • houseKey: The unique identifier for the house entity.
  • name: The name of the house (e.g., "House Stark").
  • founder: The founder of the house.
  • region: The region where the house is located.
  • characters: A set of Character objects representing characters in the house.
